func TestMissingHostRegistrationGetsNoSignedReply(t *testing.T) {
	c, conn, _, mutations, controllerKey := testController(t)
	hostKey := registerTestHost(t, c)
	controllerCtx, stopController := context.WithCancel(t.Context())
	defer stopController()
	controllerDone := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { controllerDone <- c.Run(controllerCtx) }()
	select {
	case <-c.Ready():
	case <-t.Context().Done():
		t.Fatal(t.Context().Err())
	}
	agent, err := NewAgent(AgentConfig{
		NATSUserPublicKey:   testNATSUserKey("node-a"),
		ClockCheck:          func() error { return nil },
		WorkloadIdentity:    testAgentIdentity(),
		Cell:                "gru",
		Node:                "node-a",
		Environment:         "production",
		Roles:               []string{"terrabase"},
		Conn:                conn,
		Identity:            hostKey,
		ControllerPublicKey: controllerKey.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		Runner:              &memoryRunner{observed: make(map[string]Observation)},
		InstallRoot:         testAgentInstallRoot(t),
		StateRoot:           testAgentStateRoot(t),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := agent.acquire(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("acquire before registration removal: %v", err)
	}
	mutations.mu.Lock()
	delete(mutations.entries, mutations.key(authority.MutationRegistration, registrationSubjectKey("gru", "node-a")))
	mutations.mu.Unlock()
	requestCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 500*time.Millisecond)
	defer cancel()
	if err := agent.acquire(requestCtx); !errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		t.Fatalf("missing registration received a signed reply: %v", err)
	}
	stopController()
	<-controllerDone
}

qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION; no receipts reviewed, no build/test/project-helper/crypto/cloud/process execution. Source classifications do not establish runtime pass/fail.

Ordinary fixture starts upstream NATS server directly on loopback TCP, not natscell.Start; FileStorage1 is genuine. Deterministic NATS public-user keys identify signed subjects but server has no production JWT/TLS authentication in this fixture.

Most mutations use hybrid memoryMutations: actual JetStream publish and subject inventory, but ReadHostMutation serves its map. Successor retirement test shares same map; no independent restart/reconstruction or production authority durability credit. OrderedHostMutation root instead supplies actual authority.Runtime.

Every injected memoryRunner records map/counter behavior only. Shell artifact bytes are downloaded to protected files but not executed; no native task, cgroup enforcement, managed member launch, OCI/Vault service, drain or live production HA is proven.

One-shot backend errors, CAS conflicts, leader changes, restart gates and stalled artifact metadata are fault hooks. Delegation and reached real protocol/store readback are cited; injected outage is not a genuine backend failure.

All20 raw root bodies equal baseline and historical survival hashes. Original assertions/security/fencing obligations remain retained; no deletion, retirement, conversion completion or count promotion follows.
